subject: SIG initiation & MA plan — Solis Health scoping follow-up
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@solishealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: SIG initiation & MA plan — Solis Health scoping follow-up

Hi Maria — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the compliance path: 

Recap (call highlights)
- Solis will evaluate Redwood for an internal care-assist feature (HIPAA scope).
- Main risk areas: PHI handling (transit/rest), SOC 2 Type II evidence, data residency (US-only), and access controls for SRE/engineers.
- Procurement would like a vendor security questionnaire (SIG or CAIQ) and a short evidence bundle before legal reviews pricing.

Proposed next steps (timeline)
1) We send a SIG prefill (short version) for your security team to review — target: today. (I attached a prefill workbook + our SOC 2 summary.)
2) Your security team flags any gaps / custom questions — aim: by EOD Friday 8/20.
3) Joint MA plan: agree owners and delivery dates (we propose SOC 2 artifacts + diagram by 8/27; remaining evidence by 9/3).

Clarifying questions for your team
- Do you prefer the SIG (more granular) or CAIQ (shorter)? From the call it sounded like SIG is preferred but would rather confirm.
- Is the scope: all PHI flows (ingest, inference, logs) or only inference & logs?
- Any specific residency or encryption controls beyond standard US-only and KMS?

Attachments
- solis_sig_prefill.xlsx (SIG prefill workbook — fill the yellow fields)
- redwood_soc2-summary.pdf (high-level summary, control owners, and auditor name)

If this looks right I’ll mark the prefill as high priority and loop Jordan on delivery dates for artifacts.

Thanks — short responses work fine.

-j

--
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Security & Solutions
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | (415) 555-0184
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@solishealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security-team@solishealth.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG initiation & MA plan — Solis Health scoping follow-up

Thanks, Jonas — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick answers from our side: 

- SIG vs CAIQ: we prefer SIG since InfoSec needs the control-level mapping.
- Scope: inference and logs are in-scope; ingest (PHI extraction) will be kept in a gated staging service for now — well confirm if that expands later.
- Residency: US-only is required; we also need to see that keys are customer-managed (or integration with our KMS).
- SOC 2: we require Type II reports for the last 12 months where available; summary PDF is helpful but security will request auditor correspondence if any anomalies are noted.

Well start filling the prefill workbook and aim to return initial answers by EOD Friday. Coordinate with legal later for contract timelines.

Maria

--
Maria Gonzalez
Security Lead, IT Risk & Compliance
Solis Health
maria.gonzalez@solishealth.com | (617) 555-6642
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@solishealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 16:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG initiation & MA plan — Solis Health scoping follow-up

Thanks, Maria — great, SIG it is. A couple of operational notes and owners: 

- Delivery owners: Jordan will own the evidence bundle (network diagrams, encryption details, IAM lists) and I will coordinate SIG prefill answers with our security ops team.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS; Ill include the integration doc in the evidence bundle.
- SOC 2 artifacts: attached summary is the starting item; Jordan will follow up with the auditor contact and provide a redacted report if requested.

Proposed MA plan (dates)
- 8/21: Solis returns prefill workbook (initial pass).
- 8/24: Redwood provides network/dataflow diagram + KMS integration doc.
- 8/27: Redwood provides SOC 2 redacted report + control owner contact info.
- 9/03: Outstanding answers and final evidence bundle delivered.

If that timeline works for you, please confirm and well create a shared folder (link in my next email). Also tagging Kim to check if any additional legal gateway steps are typical for health customers.

Best,
Jonas
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@solishealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG initiation & MA plan — Solis Health scoping follow-up

Morning Maria — Jordan here. Confirming the timeline from Jonas looks good from our side; a couple extra items well include in the 8/24 drop: 

- Redacted SOC 2 artifact and auditor contact (as requested).
- Topology diagram showing PHI segmentation and log retention boundaries.
- Sample IAM policy export and a list of SRE/service accounts with roles.

If you need a compressed summary for procurement (one pager) I can produce that alongside the evidence bundle.

One ask from my side: can you share the preferred format for the completed SIG prefill (XLS vs CSV)? Were fine either way but want to make ingestion into your tracker straightforward.

Thanks — Jordan
